Privacy.

This site is designed to work without advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Hosting providers may process standard request information, such as IP address and access logs, to serve and protect the website.

If you send a contact message, its contents and your email address are processed by the configured delivery provider so we can respond. The contact form may use Cloudflare Turnstile to reduce spam. Do not send passwords or sensitive information.

Questions about your message or this policy can be sent through the contact page. Review this policy against the actual hosting and delivery configuration before launch.
